name: PAL GROUP Holdings Co Ltd
summary: PAL Group Holdings Co. Ltd. is a Japanese enterprise primarily focused on the fashion sector, encompassing clothing, accessories, and various general merchandise. The company's operations cover the entire value chain, including the design, production, wholesale, and retail of apparel for both men and women, as well as a diverse range of everyday items. By February 28, 2022, it managed an extensive retail network of 902 stores. Established in 1973 and headquartered in Osaka, Japan, the company officially rebranded to PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. in September 2016, having previously operated under the name Pal Co., Ltd.
